records.context: Reads the merged cell/nucleus/pathogen/cytoplasm feature tables from a spacr ``measurements.db``, annotates each row with cell type / pathogen / treatment based on laboratory microplate metadata, filters objects by size and intensity, computes the pathogen-to-cytoplasm mean-intensity ratio for ``channel_of_interest``, groups by well and writes both ``results/cells.csv`` and ``results/wells.csv`` alongside recruitment plots. With ``field_qc`` it also writes ``results/field_qc.csv`` (every microscope field of view with its pass / fail reason); with ``confounder_covariates`` it writes ``results/confounder_report.csv``; with ``adjust_covariates`` it writes ``results/covariate_model.csv``.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#1
records.source: Reads the merged cell/nucleus/pathogen/cytoplasm feature tables from a spacr ``measurements.db``, annotates each row with cell type / pathogen / treatment based on plate metadata, filters objects by size and intensity, computes the pathogen-to-cytoplasm mean-intensity ratio for ``channel_of_interest``, groups by well and writes both ``results/cells.csv`` and ``results/wells.csv`` alongside recruitment plots. With ``field_qc`` it also writes ``results/field_qc.csv`` (every field with its pass / fail reason); with ``confounder_covariates`` it writes ``results/confounder_report.csv``; with ``adjust_covariates`` it writes ``results/covariate_model.csv``.
records.translation: Lit les tables de caractéristiques fusionnées cellule/noyau/pathogène/cytoplasme d’une ``measurements.db`` spacr, annote chaque ligne avec le type cellulaire / le pathogène / le traitement d’après les métadonnées de la plaque, filtre les objets selon la taille et l’intensité, calcule le rapport des intensités moyennes pathogène/cytoplasme pour ``channel_of_interest``, regroupe par puits et écrit à la fois ``results/cells.csv`` et ``results/wells.csv``, ainsi que des graphiques de recrutement. Avec ``field_qc``, elle écrit aussi ``results/field_qc.csv`` (chaque champ avec son motif d’acceptation / de rejet) ; avec ``confounder_covariates``, elle écrit ``results/confounder_report.csv`` ; avec ``adjust_covariates``, elle écrit ``results/covariate_model.csv``.

records.context: ``field_qc`` — when True, count cells and pathogens per microscope field of view, flag crowded / sparse / over-infected microscope fields of view and drop their objects before the per-microplate sample position grouping. Tuned by ``field_qc_mad``, ``field_qc_min_cells``, ``field_qc_max_pathogens_per_cell`` and ``field_qc_columns``. Default False.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#14
records.source: ``field_qc`` — when True, count cells and pathogens per field, flag crowded / sparse / over-infected fields and drop their objects before the per-well grouping. Tuned by ``field_qc_mad``, ``field_qc_min_cells``, ``field_qc_max_pathogens_per_cell`` and ``field_qc_columns``. Default False.
records.translation: ``field_qc`` — si True, compte les cellules et les pathogènes par champ, signale les champs surpeuplés / trop clairsemés / surinfectés et écarte leurs objets avant le regroupement par puits. Réglé par ``field_qc_mad``, ``field_qc_min_cells``, ``field_qc_max_pathogens_per_cell`` et ``field_qc_columns``. Valeur par défaut : False.

records.context: ``confounder_covariates`` — columns screened as confounders of ``recruitment`` across ``condition``. The field density columns ``n_cells_field``, ``n_pathogens_field`` and ``pathogens_per_cell_field`` are attached when requested.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#15
records.source: ``confounder_covariates`` — columns screened as confounders of ``recruitment`` across ``condition``. The field density columns ``n_cells_field``, ``n_pathogens_field`` and ``pathogens_per_cell_field`` are attached when requested.
records.translation: ``confounder_covariates`` — colonnes examinées comme facteurs de confusion de ``recruitment`` entre les valeurs de ``condition``. Les colonnes de densité par champ ``n_cells_field``, ``n_pathogens_field`` et ``pathogens_per_cell_field`` sont ajoutées lorsqu’elles sont demandées.

records.context: ``adjust_covariates`` — columns regressed out of ``recruitment`` (pooled within-condition ANCOVA), adding ``recruitment_adjusted`` per object and per microplate sample position. Only list variables the condition does not cause: a mediator (for example vacuole size when the question is whether a mutant grows slower) is removed together with the true effect. ``adjust_log_outcome`` models the log ratio.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_recruitment#16
records.source: ``adjust_covariates`` — columns regressed out of ``recruitment`` (pooled within-condition ANCOVA), adding ``recruitment_adjusted`` per object and per well. Only list variables the condition does not cause: a mediator (for example vacuole size when the question is whether a mutant grows slower) is removed together with the true effect. ``adjust_log_outcome`` models the log ratio.
records.translation: ``adjust_covariates`` — colonnes dont l’effet est retiré de ``recruitment`` par régression (ANCOVA intra-condition commune), ce qui ajoute ``recruitment_adjusted`` par objet et par puits. N’indiquez que des variables que la condition ne provoque pas : un médiateur (par exemple la taille de la vacuole lorsque la question est de savoir si un mutant croît plus lentement) est retiré en même temps que l’effet réel. ``adjust_log_outcome`` modélise le log du ratio.
